column1: # tessl 2026-10-18 history scrub: old -> new commit SHA map
# On 2026-10-18 the eg2 session rewrote `main` and `eg2/integrate` with `git filter-branch`
# to remove an LGPL-derived src/media/resample.rs. Every commit from the first resampler
# commit onward was renamed; commits before it keep their SHAs and are not listed.
# The old SHAs were held by refs/original/refs/scrub/{main,eg2-integrate} and refs/backup/2026-10-18*/
# until those refs were pruned (see BUILD_REPORT.md, "History scrub"); after the prune this table is the
# record of them, and the old SHAs no longer resolve in this repository.
# Columns (tab separated): old full SHA, new full SHA, subject.  Rows are in topological order, oldest first.
# 102 rows: the commits reachable from refs/original/refs/scrub/* and not from main, eg2/integrate or refs/scrub/*.
# How it was matched: filter-branch keeps author, committer, both dates and the message, so the key is
# (author name, author email, author date, committer name, committer email, committer date, full message).
# Every old commit matched exactly one rewritten commit (0 unmatched, 0 ambiguous), and for every row
# the old commit's parents, mapped through this table (or left alone when they predate the rewrite), equal
# the new commit's parents. Trees: 59 rows have an identical tree, 43 differ only in src/media/resample.rs.
